text: The Patriots fell to the Bears 30-24 in a Thursday Night Football thriller in Chicago, with Caleb Williams throwing two touchdown passes to lead Round 2 of their matchup, and while film reviewers dissected Drake Maye's performance and the defensive breakdowns from the loss, there were some bright spots worth examining—particularly Rhamondre Stevenson's receiving work, which reached a career high and underscored his continued ability to do all the little things for the offense as he approaches 100 carries for the sixth straight season. The absence of starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown, who were ruled out due to injuries, clearly presented challenges for New England's protection schemes, and between the postgame reflections from Head Coach Mike Vrabel and select players, as well as the detailed film notes and game statistics, there's plenty for Patriots Nation to digest as the team looks to bounce back from this narrow defeat.
